_comment: Five difficulty levels. Edit freely - this is plain text. 'enabled' is the starting state; the booth operator can also switch levels on and off from the game screen. Keep everything safe and appropriate for a school event.

items: Strike a funny pose for 5 seconds
Do your best robot walk across the booth
Introduce yourself like a game show host
Say a tongue twister three times
Balance on one foot for 10 seconds
Act like a chicken for 5 seconds
Sing one line of any song
Talk like a news reporter for 10 seconds
Pretend to be a statue for 10 seconds
Do your best impression of your favourite teacher
Do 15 lunges, then a victory dance
Do 10 burpees at your own pace
